tags.name: Vulnerability Controller
tags.description: APIs for managing and retrieving vulnerability data, including affected packages and dependency-based vulnerabilities

tags.description: APIs for managing administrator actions and retrieving package centrality information

tags.name: Package Controller
tags.description: APIs for managing Python packages, including versioning, dependencies, and vulnerabilities

get.summary: Get vulnerability details by CVE ID
get.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific vulnerability, including publication date, description, and associated security metrics.

put.description: Updates the information of an existing vulnerability identified by its CVE ID.

401.description: CVE ID in URL does not match CVE ID in request body

delete.description: Deletes the vulnerability identified by the specified CVE ID from the system.

parameters.name: CVEID
parameters.description: CVE identifier of the vulnerability to delete

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing authentication token

delete.description: Revokes access to a collaborator. Only Owner can remove collaborators.

delete.description: Removes packages from the project configuration.

400.description: The new admin must be a current collaborator

403.description: Only the current owner can transfer ownership

404.description: Project or new Admin not found

get.description: Returns all information about the latest version of the specified package, including metadata, dependencies and vulnerabilities.

put.description: Updates metadata for all versions of the specified package.

get.description: Returns all information about a specific version of a package, including metadata, dependencies and vulnerabilities.

put.description: Updates details of a specific version, such as dependencies, vulnerabilities, and Python requirement.

delete.description: Deletes a specific version from the database and graph.

put.description: Promotes an existing user to have administrator privileges.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username of the user to be promoted to administrator

post.description: Creates a new vulnerability entry and stores it in both the relational and graph databases.

get.summary: Get packages affected by a vulnerability
get.description: Returns a list of all packages and versions that are affected by the specified CVE.

get.summary: Get transitive vulnerabilities for a package version
get.description: Returns all vulnerabilities that affect the specified package indirectly through its dependency tree.

parameters.name: packageName
parameters.description: Name of the package to analyze

parameters.name: packageVersion
parameters.description: Version of the package to analyze

get.description: Retrieves a list of project names that the current user is involved in as either owner or collaborator

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing authentication token

get.description: Retrieves full details of a specific project.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a project. Only the Owner can perform this action.

parameters.name: projectName
parameters.description: Name of the project to delete

get.description: Get the list of all collaborators for the project.
Returns a list of package versions that depend on the specified package version.
Returns a list of direct dependency for a specific package version
Returns the last version of the specified package with no known vulnerabilities.
Returns the latest version of the specified package with no known vulnerabilities, also taking transactional vulnerabilities into account.

get.summary: Get vulnerability trend over the last year
get.description: Returns the trend of reported vulnerabilities over the past year, providing insights into how the overall security landscape is evolving.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the vulnerability trend over the last year

get.summary: Get the top contributors in the last month
get.description: Returns the list of contributors who made the highest number of contributions during the last month, helping identify the most active maintainers in the ecosystem.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the top contributors from the last month

get.summary: Get the top packages by PageRank
get.description: Returns the list of packages ranked by PageRank score, representing their global influence across the dependency network. Packages with higher scores impact a larger portion of the ecosystem.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the top packages by PageRank

get.summary: Get the top packages by number of direct dependents
get.description: Returns the list of packages that are depended on by the largest number of other packages (Degree Centrality). This helps identify core packages in the ecosystem.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the top packages by degree centrality

get.summary: Get packages aggregated by risk score buckets
get.description: Returns packages grouped by their risk score into risk intervals (0-2, 2-4, 4-6, 6-8, 8-10), providing an overview of the risk distribution across the entire package ecosystem.

200.description: Successfully retrieved packages aggregated by risk buckets

get.summary: Get the most used packages in the last month
get.description: Returns the list of packages that were most frequently used as dependencies during the last month, highlighting recent trends in package adoption.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the most used packages from the last month

get.description: Returns the list of packages that are used as dependencies by the highest number of other packages across the entire ecosystem. This helps identify widely adopted and critical packages.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the most used packages

get.summary: Get the most critical vulnerabilities (Perfect Storm)
get.description: Returns the list of vulnerabilities that are network-accessible (no authentication required), have low complexity to exploit, and have high or critical severity. These represent the most dangerous threats due to their ease of exploitation combined with severe impact.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the most critical perfect storm vulnerabilities
